output: An in-process cache does not need a network call. But each worker has its own copy, so one worker can give an older value than another. A shared cache needs the network and adds another service to run, but workers can check the same entry. For this read-only dashboard, updates can be up to 60 seconds late, so I recommend the in-process option for now. Do not use that recommendation for permission checks, where an old allow decision could let someone in after permission was taken away. Check this choice again if dashboard freshness must be stricter; a shared cache by itself does not guarantee fresh reads.
